_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO for the two motor-mounted channels (1 and 3), on separate PIO blocks (channel 1 sm0/rx1 on PIO0, channel 3 sm4/rx5 on PIO1): both start at throttle 60, hold 2s, ramp together to 200 over 3s, then diverge for 25s - motor 1 accelerates to 300, motor 3 decelerates to 100. Two bidirectional replies at once show concurrent telemetry does not cross-talk: each motor's eRPM must follow its own command. Channels 2 and 4 idle (no motor mounted). Trimmed to 30s (2026-09-27) to keep the fast-iteration set fast; the earlier 60s version's phases are scaled down proportionally, not truncated. Thresholds sit well below what this bench delivers: about 255 records/s with one bidirectional motor and 225/s with two (Core 0 samples the latest capture, so this is a sampling rate, not the reply rate), a largest gap of 15ms typically and up to 62ms when the SD card flushes, and every sampled decode CRC-valid.
